verdict.rationale: Evidence covers nexus declaration (CreateNexus), retrieving existing nexus definitions, and transaction recording/calculation, but nothing shows AvaTax proactively tracking sales/transaction counts against state/country thresholds or alerting a founder before a threshold is crossed. CreateNexus appears to be for declaring nexus you've already determined, not predictive monitoring. Missing for full/partial: any documented threshold-tracking dashboard, automated alerts, or predictive nexus-crossing notifications.
